extracted.intended_audience: federal agency officials, administrative law practitioners, policymakers, and researchers interested in improving federal administrative procedure
extracted.subtask_description: A compilation of ACUS projects and recommendations that identify best practices, standards, and research priorities for federal agency procedures (rulemaking, adjudication, guidance, interagency coordination, data, and related topics).

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of ACUS products and methods
rubrics_metrics.description: ACUS undertakes many types of projects to carry out its statutory mission to improve federal administrative procedure. ACUS consultants and staff regularly prepare research studies, some of which inform the development of recommendations for action by federal agencies, the President, Congress, and the judiciary. ACUS also publishes reference guides, organizes public forums and roundtables, and prepares other resources on an ongoing basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies acceptable/typical outputs and methods for improving administrative procedure: research studies, recommendations, reference guides, public forums, roundtables, and other resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency Explanations of the Law

rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on improving public understanding through explainers (FAQs, practice guides); distinguishes explainers from formal regulations and other guidance documents.

rubrics_metrics.guidance: Study and identify sources, definitions, and common topics of agency procedural rules to inform harmonization and best practices.
